adjudication.rationale: In `packages/features/ee/payments/api/webhook.ts` the event built for payment success uses `selectedDestinationCalendar = booking.destinationCalendar || user.destinationCalendar` and then sets `destinationCalendar: selectedDestinationCalendar ? [selectedDestinationCalendar] : []`, i.e. always a single-element array (same pattern in `paypal-webhook.ts`). But this PR changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to an array and updates `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` to iterate over all destinations to create multiple calendar events. With the webhook only ever providing one destination calendar, it cannot create events for multiple hosts/destinations (e.g., COLLECTIVE/team scenarios supported elsewhere in the diff via pushing multiple destination calendars in `handleNewBooking`).
